faqs.question: How do I book an electrician?
faqs.answer: Go to the Electricians page, pick one based on their specialty, experience and rate, then open their profile and tap "Book". You will get a confirmation and the electrician is notified over WhatsApp.

faqs.question: How fast can an electrician reach me?
faqs.answer: Most electricians in Kathmandu valley respond within 1-2 hours for urgent jobs. Response time varies by electrician and current demand, shown on their profile.

faqs.question: How is pricing determined?
faqs.answer: Each electrician sets their own rate, shown per hour or per visit on their profile. You will always see the rate before booking; final cost depends on the scope of work.

faqs.question: What areas do you serve?
faqs.answer: We currently serve Kathmandu valley, including Kumarigal, Kathmandu Metro, Lalitpur, and Bhaktapur. Electrician availability may vary by area.

faqs.question: Can I buy parts without booking an electrician?
faqs.answer: Yes — browse the Products page for circuit breakers, wiring, switches, lighting, tools and solar equipment, with delivery across Nepal.

faqs.question: How can I get support?
faqs.answer: Call or WhatsApp us at +977-9841445050, or visit our store in Kharibot, Kumarigal, Kathmandu during business hours.
